channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Governo lança nesta segunda novo pacote para renegociação de dívidas; veja o que já se sabe
item.description: The federal government will launch on Monday the New Desenrola Brasil, a package of measures aimed at reducing population indebtedness, allowing renegotiation of debts from credit cards, overdrafts, revolving credit, personal loans, and FIES, with interest rates up to 1.99% per month and principal discounts of 30% to 90%. The program covers incomes up to five minimum wages (around R$ 8,000) and permits the use of up to 20% of FGTS balance for debt repayment, with a one-year ban on online betting platforms for participants.

item.title: Quaest mede influência de governadores e ex-governadores recentes nas eleições estaduais
item.description: The April 2026 Quaest poll shows that 57% of Pernambuco voters believe Raquel Lyra deserves re-election, reflecting improved approval ratings (from 51% to 62%), though she faces strong competition from João Campos. In São Paulo, 54% say Tarcísio de Freitas deserves re-election, but the electorate prefers an independent profile, not aligned with Lula or Bolsonaro. Elmano de Freitas (CE) and Jerônimo Rodrigues (BA) are also seeking re-election, with scenarios ranging from consolidated favoritism to highly competitive races in other states.

item.title: Eleitor tem até quarta-feira (6) para tirar título e votar em outubro
item.description: Brazilian voters have until Wednesday, October 6, to regularize their electoral status, including obtaining a first-time voter ID, transferring residence, updating data, or registering biometrics. After this deadline, the voter registry will close for the October general elections, which will elect the president, governors, deputies, and senators. Voting is mandatory for literate Brazilians aged 18 to 70.

item.title: Líder do PL diz que crítica de maquiador a Flávio Bolsonaro foi conversa de salão
item.description: PL leader Sóstenes Cavalcante claims the criticism by Uruguayan makeup artist Agustin Fernandez against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro — alleging he fails to connect with lower-income groups — was likely a salon conversation taken out of context, possibly stemming from a vent by Michelle Bolsonaro. He denies Michelle encouraged the remarks but acknowledges Jair Bolsonaro’s absence from the campaign trail is causing disunity and weakening Flávio’s candidacy. Allies like Cabo Gilberto Silva insist Flávio is the official candidate and that internal disagreements are normal but should not drain campaign energy.

item.title: Ganância judicial de Lula explica derrota do seu indicado para o STF
item.description: The defeat of Lula's nominee, Jorge Messias, to the STF was caused by the president's 'judicial greed'—his insistence on appointing a personal ally without seeking Senate consensus. This broke a century-old norm of pro forma ratification and revealed that Lula's criterion for nominations has been personal loyalty, not qualifications or institutional acceptability. The strategy failed by ignoring the Senate's balancing power and reinforcing perceptions of court politicization.

item.title: Atraso na compra de Coronavac gerou perda de R$ 260 mi, diz TCU
item.description: The TCU audit found that the Ministry of Health's delay in purchasing Coronavac in 2023 led to a loss of at least R$ 260 million, with 8 million of the 10 million doses incinerated due to expiration. The report cites excessive delay in contracting and poor coordination, despite warnings from the Butantan Institute. The financial impact could reach nearly the full R$ 330 million contract value.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que, se eleito, usará seu prestígio para reduzir maioridade penal
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president in 2026, stated that if elected, he will use his influence to reduce the age of criminal responsibility to 14 years for heinous crimes. The remark was made on Sunday, the 3rd, and reflects a recurring agenda of his political family.

item.title: Governo Lula tenta virar a página após derrotas no Congresso
item.description: The Lula government recalibrates its agenda after two significant defeats in Congress: the rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF and the overturning of the veto on the Dosimetry Bill. In response to these setbacks, the Executive is now focusing on launching projects and disseminating proposals to regain momentum in this election year.

item.title: Ex-devoto de Tarcísio, Malafaia abençoa candidatura de Flávio
item.description: Pastor Silas Malafaia, leader of the Assembleia de Deus Vitória em Cristo in Penha, northern Rio de Janeiro, blessed Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy during a service turned political rally. The event took place this Sunday and included allies of the Fluminense presidential candidate, reinforcing evangelical support for his campaign.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro propõe redução da maioridade penal para 14 anos
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) proposed reducing the age of criminal responsibility to 14 years for heinous crimes, torture, drug trafficking, terrorism, and organized crime, should he be elected president in 2026. He argues the measure would prevent criminals from exploiting their age to commit serious offenses, noting that such a change would require a constitutional amendment approved by three-fifths of Congress in two voting rounds. The proposal was initially introduced by him in 2019 as a PEC.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro sai em defesa de Van Hattem após discussão com general
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) defended deputy Marcel van Hattem (Novo-RS) following a heated exchange involving General Emílio during a meeting of the Foreign Relations and National Defense Committee in the Chamber of Deputies. The incident took place last Wednesday, the 29th, creating tension between legislators and military officials.

item.title: Eleição trará “ambiente de pressão política” sobre o STF, diz Eduardo
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro claims the 2026 elections will create a political pressure environment on the Supreme Federal Court, especially targeting Minister Alexandre de Moraes, and that a Senate majority could force justices to follow the law. He also reports a worsening health condition for Jair Bolsonaro, including refractory hiccups every 10 seconds leading to vomiting and pulmonary aspiration risk, following humanitarian house arrest. Additionally, he states his brother Flávio Bolsonaro leads presidential vote intentions in some major polls over President Lula.

item.title: Zema: Auxílios do governo estão criando uma geração de imprestáveis
item.description: Romeu Zema, pre-candidate for president from Novo-MG, criticized government aid programs for allegedly creating a 'generation of useless people' and proposed tightening the rules of income transfer programs. He suggested conditioning the continuation of social benefits on beneficiaries accepting formal employment.

item.title: Governo inicia campanha nacional pelo fim da jornada 6 X 1
item.description: The Lula government launched a national campaign to end the 6x1 workweek, proposing to reduce weekly hours from 44 to 40 while maintaining full salaries and guaranteeing two consecutive paid rest days (5x2). The measure aims to benefit 37 million workers, improve quality of life, reduce work-related psychosocial absences, and is linked to productivity gains, with operational impact estimated below 1% in sectors like industry and commerce.

item.title: Discussão entre general e Van Hattem vira meme; Flávio se solidariza
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro expressed support for federal deputy Marcel van Hattem after a heated exchange between van Hattem and General Emílio Vanderlei Ribeiro, head of the Army’s parliamentary advisory office, during a Foreign Relations and National Defense Committee meeting. Ribeiro was accused of attempting to intimidate van Hattem following criticisms of the Army’s high command, prompting calls for his removal and sparking viral memes on social media, including one depicting Minister Alexandre de Moraes leading the Army commander on a leash. Van Hattem filed a police report against the general.

item.title: Boulos critica Zema: defesa de trabalho infantil é ‘covardia’
item.description: Guilherme Boulos criticized Romeu Zema for advocating a reduction in the minimum working age, calling the proposal 'cowardly' and suggesting signs of psychopathy. Zema had proposed allowing children to work from age 14, citing his own childhood experience, but after backlash changed his wording to 'adolescent' and emphasized protected work that wouldn't interfere with school. The controversy arose on Workers' Day, sparking strong political backlash.

item.title: Malafaia declara apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro: "Eu sou amigo, não inimigo". Veja vídeo
item.description: Pastor Silas Malafaia declared his support for Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential pre-candidacy, stating he is a friend, not an enemy, and that he will not be pressured by radical Bolsonaro supporters ('bolsominions'). He previously advocated for Tarcísio de Freitas as the candidate but now backs Flávio due to their direct relationship and his independence from external influence.

item.title: Janones diz que Flávio será candidato “dificílimo” de enfrentar
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones said Senator Flávio Bolsonaro would be a "difficult" candidate to face in the 2026 presidential race, noting he inherits his father’s support base but may distance himself from Bolsonaro’s negative image. Janones added that while Lula is the favorite, the race is wide open and will depend heavily on social media narratives, where the right holds an advantage.

item.title: Líder democrata diz que Câmara e Casa Branca devem proibir apostas em mercados de previsão
item.description: Senate Democratic Leader Chuck Schumer urged the House of Representatives and the White House to ban trading in prediction markets, following the Senate’s unanimous vote to prohibit its members and staff from such activities. The move stems from concerns over insider trading and conflicts of interest, highlighted by a U.S. soldier accused of profiting from confidential data on Polymarket. In Brazil, the lack of regulation has thwarted plans to bring platforms like Kalshi to the country.

item.title: Em culto com Flávio, Malafaia critica Lula, STF e fim da escala 6×1
item.description: Pastor Silas Malafaia criticized the Lula government, the Supreme Federal Court (STF), and the end of the 6×1 work scale during a service at the Assembleia de Deus Vitória em Cristo, with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president, in attendance. He accused the STF of judicial activism and defended the 6×1 schedule as an acquired right. The event highlighted alliances between evangelical leaders and the Bolsonarist opposition.

item.title: Quaest: 6 de 10 estados preferem governadores independentes, mas Nordeste quer aliados de Lula
item.description: Quaest survey across ten states reveals 60% of voters prefer independent governors, unaligned with Lula or Bolsonaro, led by São Paulo (47%), Goiás (46%), Rio Grande do Sul (45%) and Paraná (44%). In the Northeast, however, preference for Lula-allied candidates dominates: Bahia and Pernambuco at 47% each, Ceará at 43%. Bolsonaro-aligned candidates perform better in the South and parts of Center-West, but do not exceed independent preferences in any state.

item.title: Jornalista português chama Luana Piovani de “hipócrita”
item.description: Portuguese journalist Sérgio Tavares called Brazilian actress Luana Piovani a 'whore' and 'hypocrite' after she criticized the right-wing party Chega and Brazilian immigrants in Portugal who support it. Tavares accused her of hypocrisy for living in Portugal while criticizing Brazilian conservatism. Some followers demanded her expulsion from the country.

item.title: Bolsonaro tem boa recuperação após cirurgia, mas depende de ajuda para se alimentar, diz Michelle
item.description: Former President Jair Bolsonaro is hospitalized at DF Star Hospital following arthroscopic surgery on his right rotator cuff, showing good clinical progress and pain control, but still requires assistance with eating due to limited mobility, as he is right-handed. His wife, Michelle Bolsonaro, said he is 'a little upset' about the situation, but he is being supported by her and under continuous medical care, including rehabilitation and thrombosis prevention. The surgery was authorized by Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes, and Bolsonaro remains under house arrest since March 24.

item.title: Governo Lula lança campanha pelo fim da escala de trabalho 6 x 1. Veja vídeo
item.description: The Lula government launched a national campaign to end the 6x1 work schedule, proposing a reduction of the weekly workweek to 40 hours (5x2) without salary reduction, benefiting approximately 37 million formal workers. The initiative aims to guarantee more time for family, leisure, culture, and rest, aligning with productivity gains and social well-being.

item.title: Flávio participa de culto de Malafaia após divergências públicas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro attended a service at the Vitória em Cristo Assembly of God church led by Pastor Silas Malafaia, months after their public disagreements. The gathering included PL and Republicanos politicians such as Douglas Ruas, Cláudio Castro, Marcelo Crivella and Sóstenes Cavalcante, with Malafaia delivering a collective prayer. Flávio stated his relationship with the pastor remains respectful and friendly, emphasizing the renewal of their alliance.

item.title: Bancada evangélica é a pior que tem no Congresso, diz Daciolo
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Cabo Daciolo (Mobiliza) stated that the evangelical caucus in Congress is the 'worst there is' for maintaining conservative rhetoric on issues like abortion and drugs while allegedly being complicit in economic irregularities. He proposed a 'Lava Gospel' to investigate what he calls a 'gospel mafia,' accusing religious leaders of commodifying faith and idolizing humans. Daciolo also criticized congressional salary increases amid Brazil's low minimum wage.

item.title: Antonelli vence GP de Miami e alcança 3ª vitória consecutiva na F1
item.description: Kimi Antonelli won the Miami Grand Prix, securing his third consecutive Formula 1 victory and reaching 100 points in the drivers' championship. Starting from pole position, he outperformed rivals Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri, who finished second and third, respectively. Brazilian driver Gabriel Bortoleto finished 12th, gaining nine positions after starting 22nd.

item.title: TCU arquiva investigação de Nikolas Ferreira por voo ligado a Vorcaro e aciona Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: The TCU archived an investigation against Deputy Nikolas Ferreira regarding the use of an aircraft linked to Daniel Vorcaro during the 2022 elections, but referred the case to the Electoral Justice for potential campaign finance irregularities. The Embraer 505 Phenom 300 was used in a campaign caravan with evangelical pastor Guilherme Batista and influencer Jey Reis to support Bolsonaro in the Northeast. Vorcaro, arrested in November 2023 over alleged fraud at Banco Master, is under investigation at the STF.

item.title: Boulos critica Zema após comentário sobre trabalho de crianças: 'Ato de covardia'
item.description: Guilherme Boulos (Psol) criticized Romeu Zema (Novo) after the pré-candidate to the presidency stated that 'every child can' help with simple tasks, calling the defense of child labor an 'act of cowardice'. Zema had said in an interview on the podcast 'Inteligência Ltda' that he worked since childhood and advocated expanding work opportunities for adolescents with protection, without interfering with school. Boulos responded on social media, stating that those who defend this on Workers' Day 'give serious signs of being a psychopath'.

item.title: Malafaia acena apoio a candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro em culto no Rio
item.description: Pastor Silas Malafaia expressed support for Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential candidacy during a church service at Assembleia de Deus Vitória em Cristo in Rio de Janeiro. He criticized the Supreme Federal Court, Justice Alexandre de Moraes, and Lula’s social programs, while defending political engagement by churches and blessing Flávio Bolsonaro’s trajectory.

item.title: Bolsonaro segue internado com quadro estável após cirurgia
item.description: Former President Jair Bolsonaro remains hospitalized at DF Star Hospital in Brasília following arthroscopic shoulder surgery on April 1, with a stable clinical condition and good evolution, according to a medical bulletin released on Sunday (3). The procedure was authorized by Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes, following a favorable opinion from the Prosecutor General, and Bolsonaro is serving humanitarian house arrest since March 24 due to a judicial decision tied to his conviction for his role in the coup plot.

item.title: Zema associa caso Master à impunidade após anulação da Lava Jato
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo), pre-candidate for president, links the Banco Master case and Daniel Vorcaro's frauds to the impunity resulting from the annulment of Operation Lava Jato convictions by the STF, arguing that maintaining the punishments would have prevented such episodes. He criticizes the Desenrola program as a palliative that does not address the structural causes of indebtedness and blames the Lula government's fiscal policy for high interest rates, advocating for the impeachment of STF ministers to restore confidence in the Judiciary.

item.title: Zema diz que se eleito à presidência do Brasil, vai "privatizar tudo"
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate and former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo-MG) stated that, if elected, he will privatize all state-owned companies under federal control. He claims this measure will help reduce Brazil's interest rates more quickly.

item.title: Malafaia diz que Bolsa Família impede Brasil de prosperar e critica o fim da escala 6×1
item.description: Pastor Silas Malafaia criticized the Bolsa Família program as vote-buying that hinders Brazil's prosperity and opposed the end of the 6×1 work schedule, claiming its supporters want to work one day and rest six. He also reiterated his criticism of the Supreme Federal Court (STF), claiming political persecution after being indicted for slander and arguing that the fake news inquiry is illegal and aims to silence critics. The service was attended by political figures including Flávio Bolsonaro, Cláudio Castro, and Sóstenes Cavalcante.

item.title: PESQUISA PRESIDENTE 2º TURNO ! LULA OU FLÁVIO: quem está na FRENTE em cada ESTADO ?
item.description: The poll shows Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in a technical tie for the 2026 presidential runoff, with significant regional variations. Lula leads in the Northeast and parts of the North, while Flávio holds an advantage in the South, Southeast, and Central-West. The race is polarized, with economy and security as central themes in voter intentions.

item.title: Redução de danos do vexame de Messias envolve abandono de Alexandre de Moraes
item.description: The defeat of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF led Lula's allies to promote an alternative narrative claiming Alexandre de Moraes and Davi Alcolumbre blocked it due to interests in the Banco Master case. However, the text argues the Senate's rejection stemmed from broader concerns about Lula's pattern of prioritizing personal loyalty over institutional independence and Moraes' problematic ties to Banco Master, rendering the Moraes-Alcolumbre alliance a convenient but reductive explanation for a historically significant institutional rebuke.

item.title: Zema diz que vai ‘privatizar tudo’ se for eleito presidente do Brasil
item.description: Romeu Zema, pre-candidate for president and former governor of Minas Gerais, said that if elected, he would privatize all state-owned enterprises controlled by the federal government to rapidly reduce Brazil’s interest rates. He added that privatization would be accompanied by administrative, pension, and social benefit reforms, though he did not specify which companies would be targeted or the exact nature of the proposed reforms.

item.title: Fala de Zema sobre trabalho infantil repercute nas redes sociais
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo), a pre-candidate for President, defended child labor during an interview on the Inteligência Ltda podcast, stating that children can help with simple tasks and citing the U.S. example where kids deliver newspapers. His remarks drew strong negative reactions from politicians like Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ), Pedro Roussef (PT-MG), and Minister Guilherme Boulos, who labeled the comments as retrograde, cowardly, and indicative of psychopathy.

item.title: TCU diz que cabe à Justiça Eleitoral analisar caso e arquiva pedido de apuração sobre uso de avião de Vorcaro por Nikolas
item.description: The TCU dismissed a request to investigate the use of Daniel Vorcaro's jet by federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira in 2022, stating the matter falls under Electoral Justice jurisdiction due to campaign-related expenses. The court found insufficient evidence of federal resource misuse and referred the case to the TSE and MPE for further review.

item.title: Bolsonaro tem boa evolução clínica e segue internado para reabilitação, diz boletim médico
item.description: Former President Jair Bolsonaro remains hospitalized at DF Star Hospital in Brasília for rehabilitation following right shoulder surgery performed on Friday. According to a medical bulletin released on Sunday, he has shown good clinical progress, was able to eat soup, and moved the fingers of the operated hand. He is expected to be discharged on Monday. Bolsonaro is serving temporary house arrest at the Solar de Brasília condominium due to a 27-year-and-three-month sentence for crimes including attempted violent abolition of the democratic state.

item.title: Bolsonaro segue internado em hospital após cirurgia no ombro
item.description: Former President Jair Bolsonaro remains hospitalized at DF Star Hospital following shoulder surgery, authorized by STF Minister Alexandre de Moraes and endorsed by the PGR. He was serving a humanitarian house arrest sentence for a 27-year conviction related to an attempted coup, granted due to bilateral bacterial aspiration pneumonia. The surgery was completed without complications, focusing on pain management, thrombosis prevention, and motor rehabilitation.

item.title: Boletim atualiza estado clínico de Bolsonaro neste domingo; confira
item.description: Former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro is hospitalized at DF Star Hospital in Brasília following arthroscopic surgery on his right shoulder performed on Friday, May 1. According to a medical bulletin released on Sunday, May 3, he is showing good clinical progress, with pain under control and no complications, and is expected to be discharged on Monday, May 4. Bolsonaro is serving house arrest authorized by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes after being convicted of attempting a coup d'état.

item.title: Bolsonaro tem 'boa evolução clínica' após cirurgia no ombro, diz boletim médico
item.description: Former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro is showing good clinical progress following arthroscopic surgery to repair the right rotator cuff, performed on Friday, May 1st. He remains hospitalized at DF Star Hospital for pain management, thrombosis prevention, and motor rehabilitation, with discharge expected on Monday, May 4th. The surgery was authorized by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, as Bolsonaro is currently serving a prison sentence for attempted coup under house arrest due to health reasons.

item.title: No 2º dia após cirurgia, Michelle diz que Bolsonaro tem dor controlada
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro reported that former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro has controlled pain and is showing good progress on the second day post-surgery for a right shoulder rotator cuff repair at DF Star Hospital in Brasília. He remains upset because he cannot feed himself due to the surgery on his dominant side, but is being assisted by his wife and monitored by medical staff, with no complications reported so far.

item.title: Elo com PT vira pedra no sapato de candidato que mira colar em Bolsonaro em Estado superbolsonarista
item.description: Adailton Fúria (PSD), a pre-candidate for governor of Rondônia, seeks to align himself with Jair Bolsonaro by sharing old videos, but faces backlash from Bolsonaro supporters after hiring a lawyer linked to the PT. He also attacked his rival Marcos Rogério (PL) for alleged left-wing ties, claiming he was part of Dilma’s base in the PDT. The race for Rondônia’s governorship intensifies as both candidates vie to associate themselves with the Bolsonaro family in a state where Bolsonaro received over 70% of the vote in 2022.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro participa de culto de “amigo” Malafaia
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) attended a service at the Assembleia de Deus Vitória em Cristo in Penha, Rio de Janeiro, alongside Pastor Silas Malafaia, signaling a reconciliation after months of political tensions. The meeting took place on Sunday, April 3, and suggests a potential realignment between the senator and one of Bolsonaro’s most influential evangelical allies.

item.title: Lula lembra centenário de geógrafo brasileiro Milton Santos
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva commemorated the centenary of Brazilian geographer Milton Santos, emphasizing his importance in understanding globalization's inequalities and the transformative potential of peripheries. Lula stressed that Santos's thought remains relevant and necessary amid current geopolitical shifts, referencing his critique of globalization as a process that deepens local differences despite promises of homogenization.

item.title: Flávio defende redução da maioridade penal após estupro coletivo
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and other right-wing politicians advocated for lowering the age of criminal responsibility following a gang rape of two girls aged 7 and 10 in São Paulo, committed by four teenagers and one adult. Bolsonaro stated he supports reducing the age to 16 generally and to 14 in rape cases, referencing a constitutional amendment proposal (PEC) under Senate review. The incident sparked widespread social media debate, with backing from figures such as Nikolas Ferreira, Carlos Jordy, and Bombeiro Rafa, who stressed the urgency of addressing impunity among juvenile offenders.

item.title: Coordenador da campanha de Lula diz que Flávio Bolsonaro bateu no teto
item.description: Wellington Dias, coordinator of Lula's re-election campaign, says Flávio Bolsonaro's rise in polls stems from inheriting his father's political space but has plateaued for about 60 days. He claims Lula remains ahead in polling averages and predicts the 2026 election will be less tense than 2022, despite ongoing fake news and hatred. Dias emphasizes voters will prioritize substantive policy content, particularly stability, security, economic growth, and social improvement, resulting from the Lula government's revival of social programs.

item.title: Haddad usará caso do Banco Master para atacar Tarcísio de Freitas em SP
item.description: Fernando Haddad, the PT's pre-candidate for São Paulo governor, plans to use the Banco Master scandal to attack his rival Tarcísio de Freitas, emphasizing he never met Vorcaro or received illicit funds. The campaign will highlight that Bolsonaro received R$3 million and Tarcísio R$2 million from Vorcaro's relatives in 2022, mirroring the PT's national strategy against Flávio Bolsonaro.
